args.sql:
WITH DynastyConservation AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artdynasty AS Dynasty,
        SUM(ra.conservepriorityscore) AS TotalConservationPriorityIndex,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus ILIKE '%adequate%' THEN 1 END) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus ILIKE '%insufficient%' THEN 1 END) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(cm.conservefreq) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM conservationandmaintenance cm_sub 
                JOIN artifactscore a_sub ON cm_sub.artrefmaintained = a_sub.artregistry 
                WHERE a_sub.artdynasty = a.artdynasty 
                AND cm_sub.budgetallocstatus ILIK '%insufficient%'
            ) THEN 'Budget Crisis'
            ELSE 'Within Budget'
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        artifactscore a
    LEFT JOIN 
        riskassessments ra ON a.artregistry = ra.artrefconcerned
    LEFT JOIN 
        conservationandmaintenance cm ON a.artregistry = cm.artrefmaintained
    GROUP BY 
        a.artdynasty
),
SummaryRow AS (
    SELECT 
        'ALL DYNASTIES' AS Dynasty,
        SUM(TotalConservationPriorityIndex) AS TotalConservationPriorityIndex,
        SUM(AdequateFundingCount) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        SUM(InsufficientFundingCount) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(BudgetEfficiencyValue) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        MAX(CASE WHEN BudgetStatus = 'Budget Crisis' THEN 'Budget Crisis' ELSE 'Within Budget' END) AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        DynastyConservation
)

SELECT * FROM DynastyConservation
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM SummaryRow;

        SUM(TotalConservationPriorityIndex) AS TotalConservationPriorityIndex,
        SUM(AdequateFundingCount) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        SUM(InsufficientFundingCount) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(BudgetEfficiencyValue) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        MAX(CASE WHEN BudgetStatus = 'Budget Crisis' THEN 'Budget Crisis' ELSE 'Within Budget' END) AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        DynastyConservation
)

SELECT * FROM DynastyConservation
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM SummaryRow;

WITH DynastyConservation AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artdynasty AS Dynasty,
        SUM(ra.conservepriorityscore) AS TotalConservationPriorityIndex,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus ILIKE '%adequate%' THEN 1 END) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus ILIKE '%insufficient%' THEN 1 END) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(cm.conservefreq) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM conservationandmaintenance cm_sub 
                JOIN artifactscore a_sub ON cm_sub.artrefmaintained = a_sub.artregistry 
                WHERE a_sub.artdynasty = a.artdynasty 
                AND cm_sub.budgetallocstatus ILIKE '%insufficient%'
            ) THEN 'Budget Crisis'
            ELSE 'Within Budget'
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        artifactscore a
    LEFT JOIN 
        riskassessments ra ON a.artregistry = ra.artrefconcerned
    LEFT JOIN 
        conservationandmaintenance cm ON a.artregistry = cm.artrefmaintained
    GROUP BY 
        a.artdynasty
),
SummaryRow AS (
    SELECT 
        'ALL DYNASTIES' AS Dynasty,
        SUM(TotalConservationPriorityIndex) AS TotalConservationPriorityIndex,
        SUM(AdequateFundingCount) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        SUM(InsufficientFundingCount) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(BudgetEfficiencyValue) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        MAX(CASE WHEN BudgetStatus = 'Budget Crisis' THEN 'Budget Crisis' ELSE 'Within Budget' END) AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        DynastyConservation
)

SELECT * FROM DynastyConservation
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM SummaryRow;
